name: aoverview
description: Dashboard locale del lavoro degli agent, alimentata tramite MCP.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aoverview/core && npm run build -w @aoverview/mcp && npm run build -w @aoverview/api && npm run build -w @aoverview/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aoverview/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @aoverview/core && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
